title: Studio musicians are mostly jazz-oriented and read at sight
summary: Callender says most studio players have a jazz background and the sight-reading sessions are the norm.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: That is a somewhat undocumented part of Jazz musicians' lives on the West Coast.

Yeah. Well, very few people know that most of the musicians who work in the studios are Jazz orientated. Even you find with the string players now... The string players are getting younger and younger, and better and better, although those that have been doing the work for years are all marvelous musicians. You know, I took... Every now and then, someone would want to go on a date, and they'd see how it happened, and they'd just pass the music out and we'd play it, check if there's any wrong notes, then we'd play it, then they'd get a balance and record it right away. Most people think this is amazing, but this is the norm for here.
